{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "ipc",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "src/bitcoin.cpp is the wrapper binary explicitly covered under IPC process management and platform coverage.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.45,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes the bitcoin wrapper on Windows so that it waits for child processes and propagates exit codes rather than exiting immediately. This restores expected process lifecycle behavior for multiprocess binaries and re-enables functional tests on Windows."
    },
    {
      "name": "tests",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Changes to test_framework.py and functional test scripts simply un-skip tests now that the Windows wrapper behavior is fixed.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "test coverage",
      "rationale": "Edits to functional tests and the test framework follow directly from the wrapper fix rather than altering general test infrastructure."
    },
    {
      "name": "tools",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "src/bitcoin.cpp implements the bitcoin CLI wrapper executable, which is explicitly covered under tools.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.4,
      "reason_tag": "platform fix",
      "rationale": "Fixes a platform-specific flaw where the bitcoin wrapper on Windows exited immediately with code 0 instead of waiting on the spawned child process. This makes external invocation and automation reliable on Windows."
    },
    {
      "name": "utils",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "src/util/exec.cpp modifies the core util::ExecVp process execution helper.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Updates util::ExecVp on Windows to use _spawnvp and _cwait instead of _execvp, and reports POSIX errno errors with std::generic_category()."
    }
  ],
